name: nist-ai-rmf
title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework readiness
note: Control mappings are the author's reading of each provision, written to make engineering readiness checkable. They are not legal advice and do not decide what a regulation requires of you. Check the text and your counsel, and edit this file to match their view.

controls.title: Legal and regulatory requirements understood
controls.remedy: Map the laws and regulations that apply to the system and keep the mapping managed.

controls.title: Roles and responsibilities documented
controls.remedy: Name an accountable owner and write down who decides, who is told and how a problem escalates.

controls.title: Third-party and supply-chain risk handled
controls.remedy: Assess the risks of the third-party models, data and services the system depends on.

controls.title: Intended purpose and context documented
controls.remedy: Write down what the system is for, who uses it, who it affects and where it is deployed.

controls.title: Impacts identified by likelihood and magnitude
controls.remedy: Identify the harms and benefits to people and organisations and rate their likelihood and magnitude.

controls.title: Metrics selected for the risks that matter
controls.remedy: Choose the metrics for each identified risk and say which risks are not measured and why.

controls.title: Validity and reliability demonstrated
controls.remedy: Test the system under conditions like deployment and record where it is valid and where it is not.

controls.title: Safety evaluated
controls.remedy: Evaluate the system for safety risks before deployment and on a schedule after.

controls.title: Security and resilience evaluated
controls.remedy: Test the system for security and resilience, including adversarial inputs.

controls.title: Model explained and outputs interpreted
controls.remedy: Document how the model's outputs are explained and interpreted in its context.

controls.title: Privacy risk examined
controls.remedy: Examine the privacy risk of the system and record what was found and done.

controls.title: Fairness and bias evaluated
controls.remedy: Evaluate fairness and bias with a documented method and record the result. An inconclusive result does not pass.

controls.title: Decision to deploy is documented against purpose
controls.remedy: Record whether the system achieves its intended purpose and the decision to proceed, with the risks accepted.

controls.title: Mechanisms to deactivate the system
controls.remedy: Write and test the procedure to supersede or deactivate the system when it behaves outside its intended use.

controls.title: Post-deployment monitoring
controls.remedy: Plan and run monitoring after deployment, with appeal and override mechanisms and a way to feed findings back.

controls.title: Incidents tracked and communicated
controls.remedy: Track incidents and errors, and communicate them to the affected parties and responders.
